# Individual gene expression

### Setup

This script estimates DESeq2 median-ratio size factors directly from the count
matrix and plots normalized counts in the same style as the module eigengene
plot in `ShootWGCNA_test.Rmd`.

```{r expression-setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

library(here)
project_library <- here(".r-library", paste(R.version$major,
                                           strsplit(R.version$minor, "\\.")[[1]][1],
                                           sep = "."))
if (dir.exists(project_library)) .libPaths(c(project_library, .libPaths()))
in_dir <- here("Data", "data_for_publication")
expression_out_dir <- file.path(in_dir, "Gene_expression")
library(DESeq2)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
```

### User inputs

```{r expression-user-inputs}
## Add one or more Medicago gene IDs.
genes_of_interest <- c("MtrunA17_Chr1g0156231",
"MtrunA17_Chr7g0219081",
"MtrunA17_Chr3g0103441",
"MtrunA17_Chr4g0051121",
"MtrunA17_Chr3g0105411"
)

design_file <- file.path(in_dir, "Trait_A17_sunn.csv")
count_file <- file.path(in_dir, "ShootCounts_A17_sunn.csv")

## These samples were excluded from the shoot DESeq/WGCNA analyses.
excluded_sample_ids <- c("MTNC159", "MTNC184")

minimum_total_count <- 10
output_dir <- file.path(expression_out_dir, "gene_expression_plots", "shoot")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

### Create the DESeq2 object and normalized-count matrix

```{r expression-normalize-counts}
if (!file.exists(design_file)) {
  stop("Design file not found: ", design_file)
}
if (!file.exists(count_file)) {
  stop("Count file not found: ", count_file)
}

sample_data <- readr::read_csv(design_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
count_data <- readr::read_csv(count_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

required_traits <- c("RNA.seq.id", "Line", "CO2", "Nitrogen")
missing_traits <- setdiff(required_traits, names(sample_data))
if (length(missing_traits) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required trait column(s): ", paste(missing_traits, collapse = ", "))
}
if (!"GeneID" %in% names(count_data)) {
  stop("The count file must contain a GeneID column.")
}
if (anyDuplicated(count_data$GeneID)) {
  stop("The count file contains duplicated GeneID values.")
}

count_matrix <- as.matrix(count_data[, setdiff(names(count_data), "GeneID")])
storage.mode(count_matrix) <- "numeric"
rownames(count_matrix) <- count_data$GeneID

shared_samples <- intersect(colnames(count_matrix), sample_data$RNA.seq.id)
shared_samples <- setdiff(shared_samples, excluded_sample_ids)
if (length(shared_samples) == 0) {
  stop("No shared samples remain after matching the input files and exclusions.")
}

sample_data <- sample_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(RNA.seq.id %in% shared_samples) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(RNA.seq.id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(sample_data) <- sample_data$RNA.seq.id
sample_data <- sample_data[shared_samples, , drop = FALSE]

count_matrix <- round(count_matrix[, shared_samples, drop = FALSE])
keep_genes <- rowSums(count_matrix) >= minimum_total_count
count_matrix <- count_matrix[keep_genes, , drop = FALSE]

sample_data$Line <- factor(sample_data$Line, levels = c("A17", "sunn"))
sample_data$CO2 <- factor(sample_data$CO2, levels = c("AC", "EC"))
sample_data$Nitrogen <- as.numeric(as.character(sample_data$Nitrogen))

if (anyNA(sample_data$Line) || anyNA(sample_data$CO2) ||
    anyNA(sample_data$Nitrogen)) {
  stop("Line, CO2, or Nitrogen contains missing or unrecognized values.")
}

## Estimate the same default median-ratio size factors used by
## estimateSizeFactors(), directly from the count matrix. This notebook does not
## need a DESeqDataSet, and avoiding one also bypasses the ExpData S4 class-cache
## bug in affected Bioconductor 3.21 installations.
size_factors <- DESeq2::estimateSizeFactorsForMatrix(count_matrix)
normalized_counts <- sweep(count_matrix, 2, size_factors, FUN = "/")

missing_genes <- setdiff(genes_of_interest, rownames(normalized_counts))
if (length(missing_genes) > 0) {
  warning(
    "Gene(s) absent or removed by the minimum-count filter: ",
    paste(missing_genes, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

cat("Samples normalized: ", ncol(normalized_counts), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Genes retained: ", nrow(normalized_counts), "\n", sep = "")
```

### Plot normalized counts

Each panel shows individual samples, treatment mean +/- 1 SD, and a
LOESS-smoothed nitrogen response for each CO2 treatment.

```{r expression-gene-expression-plot-function}
plot_normalized_gene <- function(
    gene_id,
    norm_counts = normalized_counts,
    metadata = sample_data,
    co2_levels = c("AC", "EC"),
    nitrogen_levels = NULL,
    line_width = 1.2,
    smooth_span = 0.75,
    sample_point_size = 1.8,
    sample_point_alpha = 0.7,
    detect_outliers = TRUE,
    outlier_coefficient = 1.5,
    print_anova = TRUE,
    save_plot = TRUE,
    plot_output_dir = output_dir) {

  if (!gene_id %in% rownames(norm_counts)) {
    warning("Gene not available in the normalized-count matrix: ", gene_id)
    return(NULL)
  }

  sample_ids <- intersect(colnames(norm_counts), rownames(metadata))
  plot_df <- metadata[sample_ids, , drop = FALSE] %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Sample = sample_ids,
      NormalizedCount = as.numeric(norm_counts[gene_id, sample_ids]),
      Line = factor(Line),
      CO2 = factor(CO2, levels = co2_levels),
      Nitrogen_mM = as.numeric(as.character(Nitrogen))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(NormalizedCount),
      !is.na(Line),
      !is.na(CO2),
      is.finite(Nitrogen_mM)
    )

  if (!is.null(nitrogen_levels)) {
    selected_nitrogen_levels <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(as.character(nitrogen_levels))
    )
    if (
      length(selected_nitrogen_levels) == 0L ||
      anyNA(selected_nitrogen_levels) ||
      any(!is.finite(selected_nitrogen_levels))
    ) {
      stop("nitrogen_levels must contain one or more finite numeric values.")
    }
    selected_nitrogen_levels <- unique(selected_nitrogen_levels)

    unavailable_nitrogen_levels <- setdiff(
      selected_nitrogen_levels,
      sort(unique(plot_df$Nitrogen_mM))
    )
    if (length(unavailable_nitrogen_levels) > 0L) {
      warning(
        "Requested nitrogen level(s) not found for ", gene_id, ": ",
        paste(unavailable_nitrogen_levels, collapse = ", ")
      )
    }

    plot_df <- plot_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(Nitrogen_mM %in% selected_nitrogen_levels)
  }

  removed_outliers <- plot_df[0, , drop = FALSE]
  if (detect_outliers) {
    plot_df <- plot_df %>%
      dplyr::group_by(Line, CO2, Nitrogen_mM) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        .Q1 = stats::quantile(NormalizedCount, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        .Q3 = stats::quantile(NormalizedCount, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
        .IQR = stats::IQR(NormalizedCount, na.rm = TRUE),
        .is_outlier = NormalizedCount < (.Q1 - outlier_coefficient * .IQR) |
          NormalizedCount > (.Q3 + outlier_coefficient * .IQR)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup()

    removed_outliers <- plot_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(.is_outlier) %>%
      dplyr::select(-.Q1, -.Q3, -.IQR, -.is_outlier)

    plot_df <- plot_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(!.is_outlier) %>%
      dplyr::select(-.Q1, -.Q3, -.IQR, -.is_outlier)

    cat(
      "\n", gene_id, ": removed ", nrow(removed_outliers),
      " outlier(s) using the ", outlier_coefficient,
      " x IQR rule within Line x CO2 x Nitrogen groups",
      if (nrow(removed_outliers) > 0) {
        paste0(": ", paste(removed_outliers$Sample, collapse = ", "))
      } else {
        "."
      },
      "\n",
      sep = ""
    )
  }

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
    warning("No observations remain after filtering for: ", gene_id)
    return(NULL)
  }

  trend <- plot_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Line, CO2, Nitrogen_mM) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      MeanNormalizedCount = mean(NormalizedCount),
      SDNormalizedCount = sd(NormalizedCount),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      SDNormalizedCount = dplyr::if_else(
        is.na(SDNormalizedCount) | is.nan(SDNormalizedCount),
        0,
        SDNormalizedCount
      )
    )

  co2_colors <- c(AC = "cadetblue2", EC = "cadetblue4")
  extra_co2 <- setdiff(levels(droplevels(plot_df$CO2)), names(co2_colors))
  if (length(extra_co2) > 0) {
    co2_colors <- c(
      co2_colors,
      stats::setNames(grDevices::hcl.colors(length(extra_co2), "Dark 3"), extra_co2)
    )
  }

  nitrogen_breaks <- sort(unique(plot_df$Nitrogen_mM))

  gene_plot <- ggplot(
    trend,
    aes(
      x = Nitrogen_mM,
      y = MeanNormalizedCount,
      color = CO2,
      group = CO2
    )
  ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = pmax(MeanNormalizedCount - SDNormalizedCount, 0),
        ymax = MeanNormalizedCount + SDNormalizedCount
      ),
      width = 0.15,
      linewidth = 0.55
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = plot_df,
      aes(x = Nitrogen_mM, y = NormalizedCount, color = CO2),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = sample_point_size,
      alpha = sample_point_alpha
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "loess",
      formula = y ~ x,
      span = smooth_span,
      se = FALSE,
      linewidth = line_width
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(name = expression(CO[2]), values = co2_colors) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = nitrogen_breaks,
      labels = function(x) format(x, trim = TRUE, drop0trailing = TRUE)
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ Line) +
    labs(
      title = gene_id,
      x = "Nitrogen (mM)",
      y = "DESeq2 normalized count"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )

  if (print_anova) {
    anova_df <- plot_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(Line = droplevels(Line), CO2 = droplevels(CO2))

    if (
      nrow(anova_df) >= 3L &&
      nlevels(anova_df$Line) > 1L &&
      nlevels(anova_df$CO2) > 1L &&
      dplyr::n_distinct(anova_df$Nitrogen_mM) > 1L
    ) {
      cat(
        "\n## ", gene_id,
        " ANOVA - Line x N (numeric) x CO2\n\n",
        sep = ""
      )
      print(summary(stats::aov(
        NormalizedCount ~ Line * Nitrogen_mM * CO2,
        data = anova_df
      )))

      for (line_name in levels(anova_df$Line)) {
        line_df <- dplyr::filter(anova_df, Line == line_name)
        if (
          nrow(line_df) < 3L ||
          nlevels(droplevels(line_df$CO2)) < 2L ||
          dplyr::n_distinct(line_df$Nitrogen_mM) < 2L
        ) {
          next
        }
        cat(
          "\n## ", gene_id, " ANOVA - Line: ", line_name,
          " (N numeric x CO2)\n\n",
          sep = ""
        )
        print(summary(stats::aov(
          NormalizedCount ~ Nitrogen_mM * CO2,
          data = line_df
        )))
      }
    } else {
      cat("\n## ", gene_id, " ANOVA skipped: insufficient replication\n\n", sep = "")
    }
  }

  safe_gene_id <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]", "_", gene_id)
  readr::write_csv(
    plot_df,
    file.path(plot_output_dir, paste0(safe_gene_id, "_normalized_counts.csv"))
  )
  if (nrow(removed_outliers) > 0) {
    readr::write_csv(
      removed_outliers,
      file.path(plot_output_dir, paste0(safe_gene_id, "_removed_outliers.csv"))
    )
  }

  if (save_plot) {
    plot_file <- file.path(
      plot_output_dir,
      paste0(safe_gene_id, "_normalized_count_plot.png")
    )
    ggsave(
      plot_file,
      plot = gene_plot,
      width = 7,
      height = 4.5,
      units = "in",
      dpi = 300
    )
    cat("Saved gene-expression plot to: ", plot_file, "\n", sep = "")
  }

  gene_plot
}
```

### Generate plots

```{r expression-plot-genes, fig.width=7, fig.height=4.5}
genes_of_interest <- c("MtrunA17_Chr5g0417791","MtrunA17_Chr8g0359921","MtrunA17_Chr3g0124761"
)

gene_expression_plots <- stats::setNames(
  lapply(
    genes_of_interest,
    function(gene_id) {
      plot_normalized_gene(
        gene_id,
        nitrogen_levels = c(2.5,5, 10, 20),
        print_anova = TRUE,
        save_plot = TRUE
      )
    }
  ),
  genes_of_interest
)

for (gene_plot in gene_expression_plots) {
  if (!is.null(gene_plot)) {
    print(gene_plot)
  }
}
```

# DEG expression heatmaps

## Purpose

This notebook plots selected shoot DEGs in eight biologically motivated
sections. Every selected gene must have a significant genotype coefficient
(`Line_sunn_vs_A17`, adjusted \(p < 0.05\)). The protein U-box/MAPK and
autophagy groups are required to be lower in `sunn`, whereas the ribosome and
chromatin/DNA-replication groups are required to be higher in `sunn`.

The significant-DEG table defines the gene list. Expression values are then
obtained from the shoot DESeq2 object and summarized across experimental
conditions.

```{r heatmap-setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center"
)

required_packages <- c(
  "ComplexHeatmap", "DESeq2", "dplyr", "ggplot2", "here", "pheatmap",
  "readr", "scales", "stringr", "SummarizedExperiment", "tibble", "tidyr"
)
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]
if (length(missing_packages) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Install the required package(s) before knitting: ",
    paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DESeq2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(here)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)
  library(tidyr)
})
```

## Inputs and output directory

```{r heatmap-paths}
deg_file <- file.path(in_dir, "DEG_analysis", "DEG_all_coefficients_combined.csv"
)
dds_file <- file.path(in_dir, "DEG_analysis", "dds_shoot.rds")
output_dir <- file.path(expression_out_dir, "DEG_heatmap")

missing_input_files <- c(deg_file, dds_file)[
  !file.exists(c(deg_file, dds_file))
]
if (length(missing_input_files) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Required input file(s) not found: ",
    paste(missing_input_files, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Curated gene list

The selected SWEET-family gene is labelled `SWEET-like` because the project
annotation calls it a "putative SWEET sugar transporter" but does not assign
the specific name `MtSWEET2c`. Additional Line-significant sugar transporters
are included to provide context.

## Read DEGs and enforce selection rules

```{r heatmap-prepare-data}
required_columns <- c(
  "coef", "gene", "gene_name", "gene_product", "log2FoldChange", "padj"
)

deg <- read_csv(
  deg_file,
  col_types = cols(
    coef = col_character(),
    gene = col_character(),
    gene_name = col_character(),
    gene_product = col_character(),
    log2FoldChange = col_double(),
    padj = col_double()
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(deg))
if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "The DEG file is missing column(s): ",
    paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

## Apply the adjusted-p threshold defensively even though the source file is
## expected to contain significant DEGs only.
significant_deg <- deg %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "", !is.na(padj), padj < 0.05) %>%
  distinct(coef, gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

selection_audit <- gene_catalog %>%
  left_join(
    significant_deg %>%
      dplyr::select(
        gene, selection_coef = coef,
        selection_log2FoldChange = log2FoldChange,
        selection_padj = padj
      ),
    by = c("gene", "selection_coef")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    passes_padj = !is.na(selection_padj) & selection_padj < 0.05,
    passes_direction = case_when(
      expected_line_direction == "Down in sunn" ~
        selection_log2FoldChange < 0,
      expected_line_direction == "Up in sunn" ~
        selection_log2FoldChange > 0,
      TRUE ~ TRUE
    ),
    passes_selection = passes_padj & passes_direction
  )

failed_selection <- selection_audit %>% filter(!passes_selection)
if (nrow(failed_selection) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Selected gene(s) no longer pass their required coefficient criterion: ",
    paste(
      paste0(failed_selection$display_name, " [", failed_selection$gene, "]"),
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

write_csv(
  selection_audit %>%
    arrange(section, gene_order) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      section, gene, display_name, selection_coef,
      expected_line_direction, selection_log2FoldChange, selection_padj,
      passes_padj, passes_direction, passes_selection
    ),
  file.path(output_dir, "selected_gene_selection_audit.csv")
)
```

## Build the gene-expression heatmap

The DEG table is used only to select genes with a significant Line effect.
Heatmap values come from DESeq2-normalized counts in `dds_shoot.rds`.
Replicates are averaged within each Line, CO2, and nitrogen condition. The
displayed value is a row Z-score of the log2-transformed condition mean, so
colors show each gene's relative expression pattern rather than fold changes
between model coefficients.

```{r heatmap-expression-heatmap-data}
## Work around missing ExpData registration in affected Bioconductor versions.
if (!methods::isClass("ExpData")) {
  methods::setClassUnion("ExpData", c("matrix", "SummarizedExperiment"))
}

dds_shoot <- readRDS(dds_file)
missing_expression_genes <- setdiff(
  gene_catalog$gene,
  rownames(dds_shoot)
)
if (length(missing_expression_genes) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Selected gene(s) absent from dds_shoot.rds: ",
    paste(missing_expression_genes, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

sample_metadata <- as.data.frame(
  SummarizedExperiment::colData(dds_shoot)
) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    sample,
    Line = factor(as.character(Line), levels = c("A17", "sunn")),
    CO2 = factor(as.character(CO2), levels = c("AC", "EC")),
    Nitrogen = as.numeric(as.character(Nitrogen))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Line), !is.na(CO2), is.finite(Nitrogen))

normalized_count_matrix <- DESeq2::counts(dds_shoot, normalized = TRUE)[
  gene_catalog$gene,
  sample_metadata$sample,
  drop = FALSE
]

condition_key <- sample_metadata %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Line, CO2, Nitrogen) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Line, CO2, Nitrogen) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    condition = paste(Line, CO2, Nitrogen, sep = "_"),
    condition_label = paste0(
      Line, "\n", CO2, "\n", format(Nitrogen, trim = TRUE), " mM N"
    ),
    condition_order = dplyr::row_number()
  )

expression_heatmap_data <- normalized_count_matrix %>%
  as.data.frame(check.names = FALSE) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -gene,
    names_to = "sample",
    values_to = "normalized_count"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(sample_metadata, by = "sample") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene, Line, CO2, Nitrogen) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_normalized_count = mean(normalized_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    replicate_n = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    condition = paste(Line, CO2, Nitrogen, sep = "_"),
    log2_mean_expression = log2(mean_normalized_count + 1)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    gene_mean = mean(log2_mean_expression, na.rm = TRUE),
    gene_sd = stats::sd(log2_mean_expression, na.rm = TRUE),
    expression_z_score = dplyr::if_else(
      is.finite(gene_sd) & gene_sd > 0,
      (log2_mean_expression - gene_mean) / gene_sd,
      0
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gene_catalog, by = "gene") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    condition_key %>%
      dplyr::select(condition, condition_label, condition_order),
    by = "condition"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    section = factor(section, levels = levels(gene_catalog$section)),
    display_label = factor(
      display_label,
      levels = rev(gene_catalog$display_label)
    ),
    condition_label = factor(
      condition_label,
      levels = condition_key$condition_label
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(section, gene_order, condition_order)

write_csv(
  expression_heatmap_data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      section = as.character(section),
      display_label = as.character(display_label),
      condition_label = as.character(condition_label)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      section, gene, display_name, Line, CO2, Nitrogen, condition_label,
      replicate_n, mean_normalized_count, log2_mean_expression,
      expression_z_score
    ),
  file.path(output_dir, "selected_DEG_expression_heatmap_data.csv"),
  na = ""
)
```

```{r heatmap-prepare-grouped-expression-heatmaps}
full_heatmap_matrix <- expression_heatmap_data %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    display_label = as.character(display_label),
    condition_label = as.character(condition_label),
    expression_z_score
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = condition_label,
    values_from = expression_z_score
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("display_label") %>%
  as.matrix()

## Keep experimental conditions in a meaningful order instead of clustering
## columns. Colored annotation bars identify Line, CO2, and nitrogen treatment.
full_heatmap_matrix <- full_heatmap_matrix[
  gene_catalog$display_label,
  condition_key$condition_label,
  drop = FALSE
]

column_annotation <- condition_key %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    condition_label,
    Line = factor(as.character(Line), levels = c("A17", "sunn")),
    CO2 = factor(as.character(CO2), levels = c("AC", "EC")),
    Nitrogen = factor(
      format(Nitrogen, trim = TRUE),
      levels = format(sort(unique(Nitrogen)), trim = TRUE)
    )
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("condition_label") %>%
  as.data.frame()
column_annotation <- column_annotation[
  colnames(full_heatmap_matrix),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

classification_levels <- levels(gene_catalog$section)
annotation_colors <- list(
  Line = c(A17 = "#DEE757", sunn = "#F1B856"),
  CO2 = c(AC = "cadetblue2", EC = "cadetblue4"),
  Nitrogen = setNames(
    grDevices::colorRampPalette(c("#B7E4C7", "#1B4332"))(
      nlevels(column_annotation$Nitrogen)
    ),
    levels(column_annotation$Nitrogen)
  ),
  Classification = setNames(
    grDevices::hcl.colors(
      length(classification_levels),
      palette = "Dark 3"
    ),
    classification_levels
  )
)

heatmap_colors <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(
  c("#327DB7", "#F7F7F7", "#B71C2C")
)(101)
heatmap_breaks <- seq(-2.5, 2.5, length.out = 102)

make_expression_heatmap <- function(selected_sections, output_stem) {
  section_catalog <- gene_catalog %>%
    dplyr::filter(as.character(section) %in% selected_sections) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      section = factor(as.character(section), levels = selected_sections)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(section, gene_order)

  if (nrow(section_catalog) == 0L) {
    stop("No genes found for: ", paste(selected_sections, collapse = ", "))
  }

  heatmap_matrix <- full_heatmap_matrix[
    section_catalog$display_label,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  # Cluster rows separately within each classification.
  clustered_gene_labels <- unlist(
    lapply(
      selected_sections,
      function(section_name) {
        section_labels <- section_catalog %>%
          dplyr::filter(as.character(section) == section_name) %>%
          dplyr::pull(display_label)

        if (length(section_labels) <= 1L) {
          return(section_labels)
        }

        section_matrix <- heatmap_matrix[
          section_labels,
          ,
          drop = FALSE
        ]
        section_labels[
          stats::hclust(stats::dist(section_matrix))$order
        ]
      }
    ),
    use.names = FALSE
  )
  heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_matrix[
    clustered_gene_labels,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  row_annotation <- section_catalog %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      display_label,
      Classification = factor(
        as.character(section),
        levels = selected_sections
      )
    ) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("display_label") %>%
    as.data.frame()
  row_annotation <- row_annotation[
    rownames(heatmap_matrix),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  class_sizes <- table(row_annotation$Classification)
  row_gaps <- head(cumsum(as.integer(class_sizes)), -1L)
  line_gap <- sum(column_annotation$Line == "A17")

  heatmap_plot <- pheatmap::pheatmap(
    heatmap_matrix,
    scale = "none",
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    gaps_row = row_gaps,
    gaps_col = line_gap,
    annotation_row = row_annotation,
    annotation_col = column_annotation,
    annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
    annotation_names_row = TRUE,
    annotation_names_col = TRUE,
    color = heatmap_colors,
    breaks = heatmap_breaks,
    border_color = NA,
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    show_colnames = FALSE,
    fontsize_row = 7,
    fontsize_col = 7,
    angle_col = 45,
    silent = TRUE
  )

  plot_height <- max(8, 4 + 0.33 * nrow(section_catalog))

  grDevices::pdf(
    file.path(output_dir, paste0(output_stem, ".pdf")),
    width = 13,
    height = plot_height
  )
  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.draw(heatmap_plot$gtable)
  grDevices::dev.off()

  grDevices::png(
    file.path(output_dir, paste0(output_stem, ".png")),
    width = 13,
    height = plot_height,
    units = "in",
    res = 300
  )
  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.draw(heatmap_plot$gtable)
  grDevices::dev.off()

  heatmap_plot
}

pathway_sections <- c(
  "Photosynthesis", "Carbon Transporter",
  "Nitrate Uptake", "Nitrogen Signaling"
)
cellular_process_sections <- setdiff(
  levels(gene_catalog$section),
  pathway_sections
)
```

```{r heatmap-selected-gene-table}
selection_audit %>%
  arrange(section, gene_order) %>%
  transmute(
    Section = as.character(section),
    Gene = display_name,
    `Gene ID` = gene,
    `Required coefficient` = selection_coef,
    `Expected Line direction` = expected_line_direction,
```

## WGCNA module membership

Shoot WGCNA module colors come from
`Data/data_for_publication/WGCNA_analysis/gene_module_assignment_annotated.csv`. Only genes in the
BNF-related modules are kept: red, green, turquoise, magenta, cyan,
midnightblue, lightcyan, and pink. Direction is the sign of the significant
`Line_sunn_vs_A17` log2 fold change.

```{r heatmap-deg-wgcna-module-table}
module_file <- file.path(in_dir, "WGCNA_analysis", "gene_module_assignment_annotated.csv"
)
if (!file.exists(module_file)) {
  stop("WGCNA module assignment file not found: ", module_file, call. = FALSE)
}

bnf_modules <- c(
  "red", "green", "turquoise", "magenta", "cyan",
  "midnightblue", "lightcyan", "pink"
)

gene_modules <- read_csv(
  module_file,
  col_types = cols(
    gene = col_character(),
    gene_name = col_character(),
    gene_product = col_character(),
    module = col_character()
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

deg_module_table <- selection_audit %>%
  arrange(section, gene_order) %>%
  left_join(
    gene_modules %>%
      dplyr::select(
        gene,
        wgcna_module = module,
        annotated_gene_name = gene_name,
        annotated_gene_product = gene_product
      ),
    by = "gene"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    wgcna_module = if_else(
      is.na(wgcna_module) | wgcna_module == "",
      "not assigned",
      wgcna_module
    ),
    line_direction = if_else(
      selection_log2FoldChange < 0,
      "Down in sunn",
      "Up in sunn"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(wgcna_module %in% bnf_modules)

write_csv(
  deg_module_table %>%
    transmute(
      section = as.character(section),
      gene,
      display_name,
      wgcna_module,
      line_direction,
      log2FoldChange = selection_log2FoldChange,
      padj = selection_padj
    ),
  file.path(output_dir, "selected_DEG_WGCNA_modules.csv")
)

deg_module_table %>%
  transmute(
    Section = as.character(section),
    Gene = display_name,
    `Gene ID` = gene,
    `WGCNA module` = wgcna_module,
    Direction = line_direction,
    `log2 fold change` = round(selection_log2FoldChange, 3)
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(
    caption = "Selected DEGs that belong to BNF-related WGCNA modules"
  )
```

```{r heatmap-deg-wgcna-module-summary}
deg_module_table %>%
  mutate(section = as.character(section)) %>%
  count(section, line_direction, wgcna_module, name = "n_genes") %>%
  group_by(section, line_direction) %>%
  summarise(
    `WGCNA modules` = paste0(wgcna_module, " (", n_genes, ")", collapse = "; "),
    `n genes` = sum(n_genes),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Section = section,
    Direction = line_direction
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(
    caption = "BNF-module DEGs summarized by functional group"
  )
```

### Other annotated genes in the same modules

These genes are not in the curated heatmaps above. A gene is kept when it has
a gene name, a significant Line effect, and membership in a BNF-related
module, and when either the absolute log2 fold change is at least 1 or its
name matches the same families already highlighted (nitrate and nitrogen
signaling, autophagy, U-box, MAPK, cytokinin, nodulation, chromatin, or DNA
replication). The heatmap below uses a selected subset of these genes.

```{r heatmap-additional-bnf-annotated-degs}
family_pattern <- paste(
  "NPF", "NLP", "CEPD", "ATG", "PUB", "MAPK", "MCM", "ORC[0-9]",
  "HAG[0-9]", "HDA[0-9]", "HDT[0-9]", "SDG[0-9]", "CMT[0-9]", "FIE",
  "LOG-like", "CRE1", "CHK1", "NAC[0-9]", "NF-YA", "NodGRP", "ENOD",
  "CLE[0-9]", "GS1", "RRA[0-9]", "RRB[0-9]",
  sep = "|"
)

additional_bnf_genes <- significant_deg %>%
  filter(coef == "Line_sunn_vs_A17", !gene %in% gene_catalog$gene) %>%
  inner_join(
    gene_modules %>%
      filter(module %in% bnf_modules) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        gene,
        wgcna_module = module,
        annotated_gene_name = gene_name,
        annotated_gene_product = gene_product
      ),
    by = "gene"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    annotated_gene_name = str_trim(annotated_gene_name),
    annotated_gene_product = str_trim(annotated_gene_product)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(annotated_gene_name),
    annotated_gene_name != ""
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    matches_highlighted_family = str_detect(
      paste(annotated_gene_name, annotated_gene_product),
      family_pattern
    ),
    strong_line_effect = abs(log2FoldChange) >= 1
  ) %>%
  filter(matches_highlighted_family | strong_line_effect) %>%
  mutate(
    why_kept = case_when(
      matches_highlighted_family & strong_line_effect ~
        "Same family and |log2FC| >= 1",
      matches_highlighted_family ~ "Same highlighted gene family",
      TRUE ~ "|log2FC| >= 1"
    ),
    line_direction = if_else(log2FoldChange < 0, "Down in sunn", "Up in sunn")
  ) %>%
  arrange(wgcna_module, log2FoldChange)

write_csv(
  additional_bnf_genes %>%
    transmute(
      gene,
      gene_name = annotated_gene_name,
      gene_product = annotated_gene_product,
      wgcna_module,
      line_direction,
      log2FoldChange,
      padj,
      why_kept
    ),
  file.path(output_dir, "additional_BNF_module_annotated_DEGs.csv")
)

additional_bnf_genes %>%
  transmute(
    Gene = annotated_gene_name,
    Product = annotated_gene_product,
    `WGCNA module` = wgcna_module,
    Direction = line_direction,
    `log2 fold change` = round(log2FoldChange, 3),
    `Adjusted p` = format(padj, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3),
    Reason = why_kept
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(
    caption = "Other annotated Line DEGs in BNF-related WGCNA modules"
  )
```

## BNF-module expression heatmap

Colors are row Z-scores of log2 expression, averaged within each Line, CO2,
and nitrogen condition. The MtNPF transporters and MtGS1a form the nitrogen
assimilation group. MtCLE03, MtNLP3, MtCEPD1, MtCEPD2, and MtCHK1/MtCRE1 form
the nodule development and signaling group. Rows are clustered within each
group. A color strip on the left marks the WGCNA module of each gene, and the
legends are drawn in a horizontal row above the heatmap.

```{r heatmap-bnf-module-expression-heatmap, fig.width=14, fig.height=12}
if (anyNA(bnf_heatmap_genes$functional_group)) {

    "Final heatmap gene(s) have no functional group: ",
    paste(
      bnf_heatmap_genes$gene[is.na(bnf_heatmap_genes$functional_group)],
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

if (anyDuplicated(bnf_heatmap_genes$gene)) {
  stop("BNF heatmap gene list contains duplicate gene IDs.", call. = FALSE)
}
if (anyDuplicated(bnf_heatmap_genes$display_label)) {
  stop("BNF heatmap labels are not unique.", call. = FALSE)
}

missing_bnf_genes <- setdiff(bnf_heatmap_genes$gene, rownames(dds_shoot))
if (length(missing_bnf_genes) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "BNF-module gene(s) absent from dds_shoot.rds: ",
    paste(missing_bnf_genes, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

bnf_normalized_counts <- DESeq2::counts(dds_shoot, normalized = TRUE)[
  bnf_heatmap_genes$gene,
  sample_metadata$sample,
  drop = FALSE
]

bnf_expression <- bnf_normalized_counts %>%
  as.data.frame(check.names = FALSE) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -gene,
    names_to = "sample",
    values_to = "normalized_count"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(sample_metadata, by = "sample") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene, Line, CO2, Nitrogen) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_normalized_count = mean(normalized_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    replicate_n = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    condition = paste(Line, CO2, Nitrogen, sep = "_"),
    log2_mean_expression = log2(mean_normalized_count + 1)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    gene_mean = mean(log2_mean_expression, na.rm = TRUE),
    gene_sd = stats::sd(log2_mean_expression, na.rm = TRUE),
    expression_z_score = dplyr::if_else(
      is.finite(gene_sd) & gene_sd > 0,
      (log2_mean_expression - gene_mean) / gene_sd,
      0
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::left_join(bnf_heatmap_genes, by = "gene") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    condition_key %>%
      dplyr::select(condition, condition_label, condition_order),
    by = "condition"
  )

write_csv(
  bnf_expression %>%
    dplyr::arrange(functional_group, display_label, condition_order) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      functional_group, gene, display_name, wgcna_module, log2FoldChange,
      Line, CO2, Nitrogen, condition_label,
      replicate_n, mean_normalized_count, log2_mean_expression,
      expression_z_score
    ),
  file.path(output_dir, "BNF_module_DEG_expression_heatmap_data.csv"),
  na = ""
)

bnf_heatmap_genes <- bnf_heatmap_genes %>%
  dplyr::arrange(functional_group, display_label)

bnf_heatmap_matrix <- bnf_expression %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    display_label,
    condition_label = as.character(condition_label),
    expression_z_score
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = condition_label,
    values_from = expression_z_score
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("display_label") %>%
  as.matrix()
bnf_heatmap_matrix <- bnf_heatmap_matrix[
  bnf_heatmap_genes$display_label,
  condition_key$condition_label,
  drop = FALSE
]

present_groups <- functional_group_levels[
  functional_group_levels %in% bnf_heatmap_genes$functional_group
]
clustered_bnf_labels <- unlist(
  lapply(
    present_groups,
    function(group_name) {
      group_labels <- bnf_heatmap_genes %>%
        dplyr::filter(as.character(functional_group) == group_name) %>%
        dplyr::pull(display_label)
      if (length(group_labels) <= 1L) {
        return(group_labels)
      }
      group_matrix <- bnf_heatmap_matrix[group_labels, , drop = FALSE]
      group_labels[stats::hclust(stats::dist(group_matrix))$order]
    }
  ),
  use.names = FALSE
)
bnf_heatmap_matrix <- bnf_heatmap_matrix[clustered_bnf_labels, , drop = FALSE]

heatmap_row_meta <- bnf_heatmap_genes[
  match(rownames(bnf_heatmap_matrix), bnf_heatmap_genes$display_label),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
module_levels_present <- bnf_modules[
  bnf_modules %in% heatmap_row_meta$wgcna_module
]
module_colors <- stats::setNames(module_levels_present, module_levels_present)
horizontal_legend <- list(
  direction = "horizontal",
  nrow = 1,
  title_position = "topcenter"
)

bnf_left_annotation <- ComplexHeatmap::rowAnnotation(
  Module = factor(
    as.character(heatmap_row_meta$wgcna_module),
    levels = module_levels_present
  ),
  col = list(Module = module_colors),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  width = grid::unit(5, "mm"),
  annotation_legend_param = list(Module = horizontal_legend)
)
bnf_top_annotation <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
  Line = column_annotation$Line,
  CO2 = column_annotation$CO2,
  Nitrogen = column_annotation$Nitrogen,
  col = list(
    Line = annotation_colors$Line,
    CO2 = annotation_colors$CO2,
    Nitrogen = annotation_colors$Nitrogen
  ),
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  annotation_legend_param = list(
    Line = horizontal_legend,
    CO2 = horizontal_legend,
    Nitrogen = horizontal_legend
  )
)
bnf_heatmap_colors <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(
  c("#1F4E79", "#F6F4F1", "#A33B3B")
)(101)
bnf_zscore_colors <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  seq(-2.5, 2.5, length.out = length(bnf_heatmap_colors)),
  bnf_heatmap_colors
)
bnf_heatmap_plot <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
  bnf_heatmap_matrix,
  name = "Z-score",
  col = bnf_zscore_colors,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  row_split = factor(
    as.character(heatmap_row_meta$functional_group),
    levels = present_groups
  ),
  cluster_row_slices = FALSE,
  row_title_side = "right",
  row_title_rot = 0,
  row_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 9),
  column_split = column_annotation$Line,
  cluster_column_slices = FALSE,
  column_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 0),
  column_gap = grid::unit(2, "mm"),
  row_gap = grid::unit(2, "mm"),
  left_annotation = bnf_left_annotation,
  top_annotation = bnf_top_annotation,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  row_names_side = "right",
  row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 9),
  border = FALSE,
  heatmap_legend_param = c(
    horizontal_legend,
    list(legend_width = grid::unit(4, "cm"))
  )
)

draw_bnf_heatmap <- function() {
  ComplexHeatmap::draw(
    bnf_heatmap_plot,
    heatmap_legend_side = "top",
    annotation_legend_side = "top",
    merge_legends = TRUE,
    padding = grid::unit(c(2, 8, 2, 2), "mm")
  )
}

bnf_plot_height <- max(8, 3.2 + 0.42 * nrow(bnf_heatmap_genes))
grDevices::pdf(
  file.path(output_dir, "BNF_module_DEG_expression_heatmap.pdf"),
  width = 13,
  height = bnf_plot_height
)
draw_bnf_heatmap()
grDevices::dev.off()

grDevices::png(
  file.path(output_dir, "BNF_module_DEG_expression_heatmap.png"),
  width = 13,
  height = bnf_plot_height,
  units = "in",
  res = 300
)
draw_bnf_heatmap()
grDevices::dev.off()

draw_bnf_heatmap()
```
